name: 0 Plateau Assault

grid.coordinateRule: x increases down-right; y increases down-left

imageNote: Cover is broken columns, strewn across the ground level. Thin and uneven stony paths run up the sides of the area to the top. Above, on top of a large rocky outcrop a large dry tree has been set alight to cast light in the area.

altitude.connectorRule: Adjacent height changes are treated as slope/ramp unless layout terrain marks S stairs or a blocking/non-walkable cell.
